verdict.rationale: None of the first-party evidence (Habana docs or Intel product pages) publishes matrix or tensor TFLOPS/TOPS with precision and sparsity stated. The only figures are community-relayed vector FP32/FP16 numbers, which are not tensor-core throughput and say nothing about sparsity. Another commenter complains that Intel gives no useful matrix-multiply ops-per-second detail.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can size training and inference from published tensor throughput — TFLOPS or TOPS with precision and sparsity stated, not a bare marketing number
